g.text: A gesture leaves several changing traces
One real digit-2 repetition · arm 1 · med setting · three sensor modules
Pale band = approximate writing-plane window. WiFi score: median |Δ log₁₀(1+|CSI|)| over bins 6–250, per-module p95 scaling, then a 7-frame mean. Descriptive timing only.
